{{Top}}
[[File:SensorArray-XWA-render.jpg|thumb|A deep-space sensor array.]]
'''Sensor arrays''' were standard and vitally essential equipment found aboard nearly all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The arrays used miniaturized [[Processor/Legends|processors]] to gather data recorded by the ship's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and then compile it using the main [[sensor computer]]. The data assists the starship's crew in a range of activities, such as [[Astrogation/Legends|plotting]] navigation routes or scanning other vessels.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Larger arrays had the form of [[Space station/Legends|space structures]]. 

Sensor array stations were manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. They were common sector scanning units and relay systems used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to spy and report any activity in their vicinity.

Arrays were found next to their Control Station, another structure.

Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], with various skirmishes at sensor arrays throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] managed to misguide Imperial intelligence and proceeded to attack without opposition against [[IOS 24]] in order to allow an escape to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
